import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

# ---- recompute motif/contact results (values verified in previous cells) ----
motif_rows = [
 ("Q",        "264-272","GYKIPTPIQ","GYTKTTPIQ","571-579","GYSKTTPIQ","GYTKLTPVQ"),
 ("I WalkerA","288-296","CAQTGSGKT","CAQTGSGKT","595-603","CAQTGSGKT","CAQTGSGKT"),
 ("Ia",       "324-330","VSPTREL",  "LTPTREL",  "635-641","LTPTREL",  "VAPTREL"),
 ("GG",       "352-356","VYGGT",    "VYGGL",    "663-667","VYGGL",    "IYGGT"),
 ("Ib",       "373-378","IATPGR",   "VGTVGR",   "684-689","VGTVGR",   "CATPGR"),
 ("II DEAD",  "396-403","VVLDEADR", "FVLDEADR", "707-714","FVLDEADR", "LVLDEADR"),
 ("III SAT",  "431-435","FSATF",    "FSATF",    "745-749","FSATF",    "FSATF"),
 ("IV",       "494-500","VFVETKR",  "VFVSQRA",  "822-828","VFVSQRA",  "VFVETKK"),
 ("IVa",      "518-528","SIHGDRLQSQR","TIHGAREQRER","846-856","TIHGAREQRER","SIHGDREQRER"),
 ("V",        "544-556","IATSVASRGLDIK","IATAVAERGLDIK","872-884","IATAVAERGLDIK","VATSVAARGLDIE"),
 ("VI",       "574-583","VHRIGRTGRV","IHRIGRTGRV","902-911","IHRIGRTGRV","VHRIGRTGRC"),
]
mot = pd.DataFrame(motif_rows, columns=["motif","vasa_range","Vasa_DROME","GLH2_CAEEL","GLH2_range","GLH1_CAEEL","DDX4_HUMAN"])
# catalytically essential residue call per motif (from Sengoku 2006 / DEAD-box consensus)
ess = {
 "Q":"Q272 (adenine N6/N7 readout)","I WalkerA":"GSGKT P-loop, K295, T296","Ia":"R328 (RNA phosphate)",
 "GG":"G354/G355 hinge","Ib":"T375/G377/R378 (RNA backbone)","II DEAD":"D399,E400 (Mg2+ / catalytic water)",
 "III SAT":"S432,A433,T434 (ATPase-unwinding coupling)","IV":"RNA backbone contacts (E497,T498,K499)",
 "IVa":"H520,G521,R528 (RNA)","V":"T546,S547,V548 RNA; G552,D554 ATP","VI":"H575,R579,R582 (gamma-phosphate)"}
mot["essential_residues_Vasa"]=mot.motif.map(ess)
def call(r):
    v,g=r.Vasa_DROME,r.GLH2_CAEEL
    ident=sum(1 for a,b in zip(v,g) if a==b)
    return f"{ident}/{len(v)}"
mot["GLH2_identity_in_window"]=mot.apply(call,axis=1)
mot["verdict_GLH2"]=["retained (TPIQ)","retained, fully identical","retained (PTREL)","retained",
  "degenerate: P376->V (TPGR->TVGR); T,G,R retained","retained, D-E-A-D intact","retained, S-A-T intact",
  "degenerate: E497S,T498Q,K499R","retained","retained (RGLD intact; S547A)","retained, HRIGRTGR intact"]
mot["same_as_GLH1"]=mot.GLH2_CAEEL==mot.GLH1_CAEEL
print(mot[["motif","vasa_range","Vasa_DROME","GLH2_CAEEL","GLH2_range","GLH2_identity_in_window","same_as_GLH1","verdict_GLH2"]].to_string(index=False))

contact_rows=[("G218","ATP","K522","K311","H261"),("I219","ATP","I523","I312","Y262"),("F225","ATP","F529","F318","F268"),
("F247","ATP","F554","F343","F290"),("Y265","ATP","Y572","Y361","Y308"),("I267","ATP","K574","K363","K310"),
("P268","ATP","T575","T364","L311"),("T269","ATP","T576","T365","T312"),("Q272","ATP","Q579","Q368","Q315"),
("Q290","ATP","Q597","Q386","Q333"),("T291","ATP","T598","T387","T334"),("G292","ATP","G599","G388","G335"),
("S293","ATP","S600","S389","S336"),("G294","ATP","G601","G390","G337"),("K295","ATP","K602","K391","K338"),
("T296","ATP","T603","T392","T339"),("P326","RNA","P637","P426","P373"),("T327","RNA","T638","T427","T374"),
("R328","RNA","R639","R428","R375"),("G354","RNA","G665","G454","G401"),("G355","RNA","G666","G455","G402"),
("T375","RNA","T686","T475","T422"),("P376","RNA","V687","V476","P423"),("G377","RNA","G688","G477","G424"),
("R378","RNA","R689","R478","R425"),("D381","RNA","H692","H481","D428"),("D399","ATP","D710","D499","D446"),
("E400","ATP","E711","E500","E447"),("R403","RNA","R714","R503","R450"),("F409","RNA","F721","F510","F456"),
("A433","ATP","A747","A536","A482"),("E497","RNA","S825","S614","E548"),("T498","RNA","Q826","Q615","T549"),
("K499","RNA","R827","R616","K550"),("H520","RNA","H848","H637","H571"),("G521","RNA","G849","G638","G572"),
("R528","RNA","R856","R645","R579"),("T546","RNA","T874","T663","T597"),("S547","RNA","A875","A664","S598"),
("V548","RNA","V876","V665","V599"),("G552","ATP","G880","G669","G603"),("D554","ATP","D882","D671","D605"),
("R579","ATP","R907","R696","R630"),("R582","ATP","R910","R699","R633"),("V583","ATP","V911","V700","C634")]
con=pd.DataFrame(contact_rows,columns=["Vasa_res","ligand","GLH2","GLH1","DDX4"])
for c in ["GLH2","GLH1","DDX4"]:
    con[c+"_same"]=[a[0]==b[0] for a,b in zip(con.Vasa_res,con[c])]
print("\nGLH-2 vs GLH-1 agreement at all 45 ligand-contact positions: %d/45"
      % sum(a[0]==b[0] for a,b in zip(con.GLH2,con.GLH1)))

# ===================== FIGURE =====================
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13.5,9.0),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.25,1]})

# panel A: motif grid
ax=axes[0]
cols=["Vasa_DROME","DDX4_HUMAN","GLH1_CAEEL","GLH2_CAEEL"]
labels=["Vasa (Dmel)","DDX4 (human)","GLH-1 (worm)","GLH-2 (worm)"]
for j,m in enumerate(mot.motif):
    ax.text(j,len(cols)+0.35,m,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=8.5,rotation=35)
for i,(c,lab) in enumerate(zip(cols,labels)):
    y=len(cols)-1-i
    ax.text(-0.75,y,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
    for j,row in mot.iterrows():
        s=row[c]; ref=row.Vasa_DROME
        nid=sum(1 for a,b in zip(ref,s) if a==b)/len(ref)
        colr="#2a6f4e" if nid==1 else ("#5e9c7a" if nid>=0.8 else ("#d9a441" if nid>=0.6 else "#c0504d"))
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j-0.44,y-0.4),0.88,0.8,fc=colr,ec="white",lw=1))
        ax.text(j,y,s,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.0,color="white",family="monospace")
ax.set_xlim(-4.2,len(mot)-0.3); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,len(cols)+1.4); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("A. DEAD-box motif windows in GLH-2 aligned to Drosophila Vasa (PDB 2DB3 numbering)\n"
             "colour = identity to Vasa within window (dark green 100%, red <60%)",fontsize=11,loc="left")

# panel B: ligand contact conservation
ax=axes[1]
order=con.index
x=np.arange(len(con))
for i,(c,lab,yy) in enumerate(zip(["DDX4","GLH1","GLH2"],["DDX4","GLH-1","GLH-2"],[2,1,0])):
    for j in x:
        ok=con[c+"_same"][j]
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j-0.45,yy-0.4),0.9,0.8,fc="#2a6f4e" if ok else "#c0504d",ec="white",lw=0.6))
    ax.text(-1.2,yy,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
for j in x:
    ax.text(j,2.75,con.Vasa_res[j],rotation=90,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=6.5,
            color="#1f4e79" if con.ligand[j]=="ATP" else "#7a4b00")
ax.text(0,-1.15,"blue labels = AMPPNP/Mg contacts, brown = ssRNA contacts (<4.0 A, chain A of 2DB3)",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(-6,len(con)-0.3); ax.set_ylim(-1.4,3.9); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("B. Identity to Vasa at the 45 residues that contact AMPPNP/Mg or ssRNA in the Vasa ternary complex",
             fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print("\nCSV_MOTIF\n"+mot.to_csv(index=False))
print("\nCSV_CONTACT\n"+con.to_csv(index=False))
